author: Universe Scales
note: Original cross-section of a Corning SMF-28 Ultra type fiber: 8.2 µm nominal core diameter, 125 µm glass cladding diameter and 242 µm coating diameter. The core is not the 9.2 µm mode-field diameter. A quarter of the cladding and most of the coating are cut away. The surviving 10-degree coating sector preserves the full 121 µm outer radius; its thickness is not compressed to fit the glass diameter. Segment length (45 µm), cut orientations and opaque contrasting colors are authored presentation choices. No refractive-index profile, internal polymer-layer subdivision, propagating light ray or material transparency is simulated. The listed quantity measures glass diameter only.
